_note: The demo customer, exactly as the mobile app shows them. The backend seeds this into the database and refreshes it on every start (backend/db.py seed), so the person cannot drift; the app and the dashboard read it from the database through the backend. Bookings and reminders made in the app are runtime state and stay. Points here are the default fix-rule points; If staff can change them in the dashboard.

risks.title: Electrical panel from 1975
risks.why: Old fuses can overheat and cause fires.
risks.explain: Your panel is original. Panels this old often lack residual-current protection, which is a common cause of house fires.
risks.fix: A certified electrician inspects the panel and adds a residual-current device if needed.
risks.diy: You cannot do electrical work yourself, but you can book an inspection to confirm the panel is safe.

risks.title: Original water pipes
risks.why: Copper pipes over 40 years old start to leak.
risks.explain: Pipes from the 1970s are near the end of their life. Small leaks inside walls can go unnoticed for months.
risks.fix: A plumber checks the pipes with a camera and pressure test, and replaces weak parts.
risks.diy: Check visible joints under sinks for green stains, then book an inspection.

risks.title: No water leak sensor
risks.why: A dishwasher leak can damage floors overnight.
risks.explain: Water damage is the most common home claim in Finland. A sensor with auto shut-off stops the water in seconds.
risks.fix: A partner installs leak sensors and a shut-off valve.
risks.diy: Place sensors under the dishwasher and sink yourself, then book a quick check.

risks.title: Roof not checked in 6 years
risks.why: Damaged tiles let in snow melt.
risks.explain: Roofs should be checked every 3–5 years. Winter snow load makes small cracks worse.
risks.fix: A roofer inspects the tiles, flashings and underlay.
risks.diy: Look for loose tiles from the ground with binoculars, then book an inspection.

risks.title: Thin attic insulation
risks.why: Heat loss can cause ice dams on the roof.
risks.explain: Insulation from 1975 is usually thinner than today's standard.
risks.fix: A partner measures and adds blown insulation.
risks.diy: Measure the insulation depth in the attic, then book a check.

risks.title: Cottage pipes not drained for winter
risks.why: Frozen pipes burst and flood the floor in spring.
risks.explain: Water left in the pipes of an empty cottage freezes, bursts the pipes and floods the floor when it thaws.
risks.fix: A plumber drains the pipes and the water heater and closes the main valve before the frost.
risks.diy: Drain the pipes yourself with a checklist, then book a quick check.

risks.title: Fireplace chimney not swept
risks.why: Soot in the flue can catch fire.
risks.explain: Soot builds up in a flue that is not swept every year. The cottage chimney was last swept in 2023.
risks.fix: A chimney sweep cleans the flue and checks the fireplace.
risks.diy: You cannot sweep the flue yourself safely, but you can book the sweep for the start of the season.

risks.title: Boat engine not serviced in two years
risks.why: Worn fuel lines can fail at sea.
risks.explain: An unserviced engine is the most common reason a boat breaks down or catches fire at sea.
risks.fix: A boat mechanic services the engine, the fuel line and the cooling system.
risks.diy: Check the fuel line and the impeller yourself, then book a service check.

risks.title: Boat stored outdoors without a cover
risks.why: Snow and ice crack the hull over winter.
risks.explain: Snow and melt water collect in an uncovered boat; the weight and the frost crack the hull and the deck.
risks.fix: A boat yard stores the boat indoors or fits a winter cover.
risks.diy: Fit a winter cover yourself, then book a quick check.

risks.title: Winter tyres over five years old
risks.why: Old rubber grips the ice far worse.
risks.explain: Your winter tyres are from 2019. Rubber hardens with age and the braking distance on ice grows.
risks.fix: A tyre shop checks the tread and fits new winter tyres if needed.
risks.diy: Measure the tread depth yourself, then book a tyre check.

risks.title: Car not serviced in the last year
risks.why: Worn brakes go unnoticed without a service.
risks.explain: The last service was in March 2025. Worn brakes and old fluids go unnoticed without a yearly service.
risks.fix: A garage services the car and checks the brakes.
risks.diy: Check the oil and the lights yourself, then book the service.

risks.title: Ruska's vaccinations are out of date
risks.why: Parvovirus and distemper need long, costly care.
risks.explain: An unvaccinated dog can catch parvovirus or distemper, which need long and costly care.
risks.diy: There is no way to do this yourself; book a vet visit.

risks.title: Older large dog without a joint check
risks.why: Hip problems get worse without early care.
risks.explain: Large dogs over six years old often develop hip and elbow problems that get worse without care.
risks.fix: A vet checks the hips and the elbows.
risks.diy: Watch for stiffness after walks, then book a vet check.
